paper.title: Explicitly antisymmetrized neural network layers for variational Monte Carlo simulation
paper.authors: Jeffmin Lin, Gil Goldshlager, Lin Lin

results.system_description: B atom, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 3 up and 2 down electrons
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy from pure MCMC after training, without parameter updates; the parenthesized error is the standard error, estimated with the integrated autocorrelation (Sec. 4).
results.notes: N_up = 3, N_down = 2: not printed, but the 2P ground term of B lies only in this sector (up to the mirror N_up <-> N_down). The sector is not stated; the calculations use the VMCNet code, benchmarked against the FermiNet code.

The sector is not stated; the calculations use the VMCNet code, benchmarked against the FermiNet code.
